ai.title: We haven’t seen the last of the major tech outages
ai.brief: Microsoft and the US government agree there are more outages to come. Microsoft and the US government agree there are more outages to come. Over the last week or so, we have seen a nationwide FAA ground stop, a multi-day Outlook outage that brought entire companies to a standstill, and a banking outage at JPMorgan Chase . But the consensus is that there are more to come . Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton told CNN : Microsoft President Brad Smith issued a similar warning about further outages on CBS News’ Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan , but sounded a much more ominous tone.

sec.title: OpenRouter Drops 3 Providers After Researchers Catch Months of Prompt Theft at AI Hosting Firms
sec.brief: Attackers stole data from inside three AI inference providers for months, and none of the three knew until researchers told them, the industrial cybersecurity company Dragos said this week.
